romans.9.p1.b1.text: I speak the truth in Christ; I am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the Holy Spirit.

romans.9.p1.b2.text: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

romans.9.p1.b3.text: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood

romans.9.p2.b1.text: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.

romans.9.p2.b2.text: It is not as though God’s word has failed.

romans.9.p2.b3.text: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.

romans.9.p3.b1.text: … she was told, “The older will serve the younger.”

romans.9.p3.b2.text: What then shall we say? Is God unjust?

romans.9.p3.b4.text: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.

romans.9.p4.b1.text: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”

romans.9.p4.b2.text: … Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”

romans.9.p4.b3.text: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?

romans.9.p5.b1.text: including us, whom He has called not only from the Jews, but also from the Gentiles?

romans.9.p5.b2.text: I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people

romans.9.p5.b3.text: … I will call her ‘My Beloved’ who is not My beloved

romans.9.p5.b4.text: … they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

romans.9.p6.b1.text: Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

romans.9.p6.b2.text: Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.

romans.9.p7.b1.text: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith

romans.9.p7.b2.text: … They stumbled over the stumbling stone

romans.9.p7.b3.text: See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense

romans.9.p7.b4.text: … the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.
